latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Robotic Control Skill (OpenClaw) for robotic arm and gripper control.
- Supports 6-DOF arm movement, gripper operations, collision detection, and force/torque sensing.
- Includes action sequence execution, hardware auto-detection, and simulation mode.
- Compatible with multiple industrial robot brands and custom systems.
- Provides voice command interface and example code for integration.
- Performance specifications and main dependencies documented.
